name: Live Like Pmc Combat - Sain Preset
teaser: Guaranteed to lower your survival rate like live and humble you. Be scared again when a pmc walks around the corner, and upset when they send you back to the lobby to find another salewa.
description_html:
Decided to make a preset after countless times tweaking in sain across multiple versions. I have no coding experience this is just my tweaking based on so many hours of trial and error and playthroughs of spt (i swear ive spent more time doing this rather than actually playing lol). Ive always wanted the pmcs to feel like real fights and im sure some of you are also looking for that so i wanted to share it and suggestions are welcome . This is just a test alpha version, still feeling out kinks right now since bsg changes ai a lot. Check out Shibdib’s preset, i played for a few days on it and its also a good preset and inspired me to make my own.

NOTICE:

This preset is intended to be used with That’s Lit. It effects the bots difficulty, so using this preset without it could lead to terminator pmcs and harder than intended

a lot of non human advantages the ai gets are hard to combat but this helps a little i feel. I also use starting pmcs on moar for reference.

Summary and what I changed:

A lot of time has mostly went into how CQB feels, so let me know if bots feel unfair at long range like sighting instantly or it feels like the goons (i hate them). Im tweaking cover and bots going prone too much at the moment. I tested raids at low levels and high levels, mostly low. so let me know if it gets harder, this is probably hard to balance since its all ammo and gear based. hopefully bot reaction time keeps the endgame in check.

Only scav and pmcs are changed, my preset every other bot type is vanilla, you can turn this off to have just base sain settings for them or keep it on if you like.

Scavs i tried to make easy but not pushovers. Not much work into them since this is pmc focused.

All difficulties are the same so no variance if you like that, personality is the only variance the bots can have, timmy and coward are disabled since i think they’re too easy.

To save some of your guys time and to be clear: this preset is not friendly for those that want pure balance or just want to chill. this is for those that want to try and mimic the feeling of desperately fighting, clinging to your fir salewa with quick decision and aim fights winning the day like in live. You will be head eyes’d sometimes, but you’ll feel alive again. Also i don’t want the bots to be terminators, but react and kill quick up close like real players would.

At the end of the day a lot of us just want what fits our skill level and how we play so this isn’t a fit all preset and was made with my skill level, and ideas effecting tweaking to a certain extent. Take my settings and mess with them yourself until it feels good for you or drop it in sain and forget. If you do offer suggestions and made edits please make sure your observations are still on my default preset.

INSTALLATION:

Drag and drop BepInEx folder into where SPT is installed

That’s it

Have fun and don’t worry you’ll find another salewa if you can make it out alive
